name: 08_hardship_pause
description: An attestor-approved hardship pause (10 April – 10 June 2026) spans the Q1 deadline: Q1's countdown stops for 61 days, the status reads Paused, releases keep flowing, Q1's deadline and grace move by 61 days while Q2's clock (starting 1 July) is untouched, the payment on 10 July carries no accrual; a request is withdrawn (nonce advances), bounds are enforced, and a second pause is ended early by the issuer.

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces, prior/income commitments, liquidity flags) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.

steps.note: no reason is stored on-chain; nonce 1
withdrawing advances the nonce (2): a signature over nonce 1 is dead
a report-verifier key is not an attestor
pause 10 April → 10 June (61 days); pausedTotal = 61 d
tranche 2: a hardship pause never stops treasury releases (C11 §1)
15 May, past the nominal deadline: Paused
Q1 countdown = 71 d − 61 d = 10 d → OnTime
Q1 countdown 31 d → InGrace (deadline shifted to 1 July)
paid without accrual; Q2's clock started 1 July (after the pause) and is unshifted: OnTime, deadline 31 July
